description: Promotes a synthesized learning statement on an Initiative. When problemIds or evidenceChunkIds are omitted, automatically links all problems currently attached to the Initiative and their active evidence chunks (capped at 50) and echoes the resolved IDs in the receipt. Requires initiatives:write.

evidenceChunkIds.description: Optional supporting Evidence Chunk UUIDs. When omitted, defaults to active evidence chunks linked to the scoped problems (up to 50).

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse only when retrying the exact same request.

problemIds.description: Optional linked Problem UUIDs. When omitted, defaults to all problems currently linked to the initiative (up to 50).

whatUsersReport.description: Optional distinct summary of what users report.

whatWeObserved.description: Optional distinct observation from investigation or product usage.

name: initiative_learning_promote
title: Promote Initiative Learning
